Chapter 6639: Exchanging The Tribulations

Chapter 6639: Exchanging The Tribulations

Bao Pu’s shadow also dispersed into strands, unable to escape.

Spectators could tell this was the end of Light God. However, he had a smile on his face. He controlled his fate, not Bao Pu, and retained his mind until the very end.

“This is my life.” He said, preferring to die as himself than become the shell of an immortal.

However, the primordial law pulsed again like a blossoming flower and wrapped around the scattering strands.

It moved unimaginably fast and locked them all together. Time suddenly reversed as it rebuilt Light God minus Bao Pu’s parts. The latter went up in smoke, erased from existence.

Once Light God returned, he truly became his own. The remnants and secrets left behind by Bao Pu have been purified.

Grand Preceptor and the others watched in amazement. This left a deep impression on them since they had never seen such a miracle before.

***

Sixth-sense continued to bear the tribulations. The crack in the sky gradually closed and the eye no longer gazed down at them.

“Ahh!” He kept on exploding while running away.

“Let’s see how long you can last, you’ll feel like dying soon enough.” Calamities watched the fleeing man.

He then looked down at his chest and was ecstatic to be free.

“I’m free, hahahaha, I’m finally free!” He became ecstatic and shouted.

He was Liu Sanqiang again, no longer Calamities. The price to become an overlord was too much to handle. He suffered physically and mentally, only alive due to his bloodline.

He couldn’t remove the stone since it attached itself to his body and true fate. All methods proved futile. Others dreamed about being an overlord but he only wanted to escape this fate. Today, someone strong enough willingly took the stone away from him.

It had to be someone strong enough to endure the tribulations or they would have returned to Liu Sanqiang’s body.

“He’s no longer an overlord?” Spectators could see his lowered cultivation.

The crowd didn’t know what to say. The primal ancestors trained diligently to reach this goal. If they could ever reach it, they would rather die than lose it.

Thus, they couldn’t understand his joy. Of course, he felt no need to explain it either.

“Boom!” World Seal trembled and water gushed out of the spring of fortune.

Although others were excited, the water empowered World Seal and magnified its area of effect. They suddenly had a bad feeling about this because World Seal appeared to be taking Three Immortals World inside it.
